name: How long does a typical drain cleaning or camera inspection take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical drain cleaning or camera inspection take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of drain cleaning or a camera inspection can vary. A basic sink or toilet drain cleaning might take 30 minutes to an hour. More complex blockages, especially in main sewer lines or those requiring hydro-jetting, could take 1 to 3 hours or longer. A camera inspection typically takes 30 to 60 minutes, depending on the length and complexity of the pipe system being examined. We will provide an estimated timeframe after an initial assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: A basic drain cleaning or camera inspection usually takes 30-60 minutes. More complex jobs, like main sewer line issues or hydro-jetting, can take 1-3 hours or more.
